sentences.en: I guess the time of reckoning has arrived at last.
sentences.zh: 我估计算账的时候终于到了。

sentences.en: Reckon the cost before you decide to purchase the car.
sentences.zh: 在决定买这辆车之前，请先估算一下成本。

sentences.en: Ah, I reckon you go straight down this prefectural road ...
sentences.zh: 哦，我想你直接沿着这条省道走吧……
